items.title: Devil Fruits Across the Island
items.body: Rare Devil Fruits have dropped in across the map! Eat the Gum-Gum Fruit to stretch your skills as Luffy, or the Flame-Flame Fruit to come in hot as Ace... just stay away from water.

items.title: TWINDRILL DIVA Music Pass
items.body: Virtual Diva Kasane Teto takes the stage! TWINDRILL DIVA Music Pass holders get access to the Kasane Teto Outfit, Back Bling, Emote, and more. Dive into Festival to start unlocking rewards!

items.title: One Piece's Buggy Makes Landfall
items.body: A new Captain has claimed territory! Defeat the Buggy Boss, claim the Transponder Snail Sprite, and explode into action with the Special Buggy Ball.

items.title: Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp Outfits
items.body: When adventure calls, the Straw Hats answer! Set sail with Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp Outfits and chart a course to uncharted waters.
